name: Decoration Rush
description:
Grab your team and start the race to become the best decorator. You can combine sport and beauty. Be careful because your opponents have the same goals!    

The gameplay is so easy and addictive that you will never want to stop. Try out all the variations and colors.

Complete all the levels and try new tactics and tricks. Surprise your opponents with unexpected moves in the arena!   

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Decorate and brighten up your world!
